_about: Per-fixture expected findings for examples/known-bad/. Source of truth for tests/test_known_bad_corpus.py, which derives its expectation maps from this file.

Keys per fixture: miss (true = nothing fires on the encoded defect; see README.md), severity_band (highest tier of the fixture's own target codes, null for a MISS), target_codes (union of every code below, checked by the test), critical_by_point (CRITICAL codes the gate must block on at that point; a string or a list), caught_at_plan_and_execute (CRITICAL codes expected at BOTH plan and execute), high_by_point / medium_by_point / low_by_point (verify/ship codes at that tier; MEDIUM and LOW are measured with --block-on), incidental_by_point (codes tolerated at a point as documented incidentals, never credited as a catch), note.
Every fixture on disk must have an entry. Adding a fixture means adding one entry here, not editing Python dicts.
